patch.objective: Endpoint, mobile, and embedded/IoT/ICS security considerations

sources.cite: CompTIA Security+ (V7), exam SY0-701: domains General security concepts 12%, Threats, vulnerabilities, and mitigations 22%, Security architecture 18%, Security operations 28%, Security program management and oversight 20%
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-16 for this Security+ band. The page lists the five domains and weights above, says English SY0-701 retires on June 11, 2027, and describes the topics: resilience and recovery (high availability, site considerations, testing, power, platform diversity, backups, continuity of operations); third-party risk (vendor assessment, selection, agreements, monitoring, questionnaires, rules of engagement); network attacks among the malicious activities; alerting and monitoring. The objectives PDF was not re-read; the objective wording is the course seed's.

sources.cite: CISA, FBI, EPA and DOE, Primary Mitigations to Reduce Cyber Threats to Operational Technology (fact sheet, May 6, 2025)
sources.note: Relevant text: remove OT connections to the public internet; change default passwords; secure remote access to OT networks (phishing-resistant MFA for VPN access, least privilege, disable dormant accounts); 'Segment IT and OT networks', 'introducing a demilitarized zone for passing control data to enterprise logistics'; 'Practice and maintain the ability to operate manually': 'The capability for organizations to revert to manual controls to quickly restore operations is vital'. Read through a summarizing fetch of the PDF on 2026-11-11.

sources.cite: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3, Incident Response Recommendations and Considerations for Cybersecurity Risk Management: A CSF 2.0 Community Profile (April 2025)
sources.note: The current revision (April 3, 2025; supersedes Rev. 2 of 2012). Relevant text: RS.MA-02 'Perform a preliminary review of a new incident report to verify that a cybersecurity incident has occurred, then estimate the severity of the incident and the level of urgency'; RS.MA-03 'Prioritize how quickly incident response should be performed for each incident based on its scope, likely impact, time-critical nature, and resource availability'; RS.MA-04 escalation and elevation; RS.MI-01 'Containment refers to preventing the expansion of an incident'; RS.MI-02 eradication 'to eliminate persistence mechanisms and entry points' and 'Identify all affected hosts and services'; RS.AN-07 incident data collected with integrity and provenance preserved; RS.CO-02 stakeholders notified. Read in the PDF text (nvlpubs.nist.gov) and the CSRC page on 2026-11-11.

sources.cite: CrowdStrike, 2026 Global Threat Report (press release, 2026-02-24): 'The average eCrime breakout time fell to just 29 minutes in 2025', the fastest observed 27 seconds
sources.note: Vendor telemetry, not a standard. Also: '42% of vulnerabilities were exploited before public disclosure'; adversaries injected malicious prompts into GenAI tools at more than 90 organizations. Used only to set the scale of the attacker's clock; the scenario's step times are the author's. Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-11.
